text:
maya: heads-up — intermittent corrupted embeddings in sampleapp rerank. after a retry cycle some items are 1536 instead of the expected 1024
kevin: corrupted how? concat? different model?
maya: looks like client-side merge bug in batcher helper v0.3. retry returned a partial and merge logic appended it instead of replacing, producing 1024+512 = 1536 vectors
sam: can you paste the merge snippet?
maya: guilty code below:
```
// batcher v0.3 (node)
function mergeBatchResponses(baseBatch, partialBatch) {
  return baseBatch.map((b, i) => {
    if (!partialBatch[i]) return b;
    // old thinking: partials are segments -> concat
    return b.concat(partialBatch[i]);
  });
}
```
alex: that will definitely produce longer vectors. python helper raised on dim mismatch, node helper was lenient — parity gap
kevin: we also observed retry header differences. first attempt had `x-batch-id` + `x-request-group`, retry path used `x-batch-id` but not `x-request-group`, which allowed SmartRouting to pick a cheaper variant (512-dim) for the retry response
maya: repro logs (local):
```
[2026-03-21T09:10:02Z] batch=bb-900 attempt=1 POST /v1/embeddings ids=8 dim=1024
[2026-03-21T09:10:03Z] batch=bb-900 attempt=2 POST /v1/embeddings ids=8 dim=512
[2026-03-21T09:10:04Z] client-merge => embedding[3] length=1536
```
sam: root cause: (1) server routed a different model for retry due to header mismatch, (2) client concat merged incompatible shapes. Both need fixes
kevin: proposed fixes:
- client: change merge semantics -> replace partials, not concat; validate dims and throw on mismatch
- client: add strict check and debug flag to log shapes before merge
- infra: make `x-request-group` + `x-batch-id` required for consistent routing in our test harness or ensure retries copy all routing headers
- docs: clarify canonical response keys (`embedding` vs `embeddings`) and expected dim per model in onboarding guide
- sdk tests: add parity tests between node/python helpers to catch this regressions
maya: quick patch pushed to sampleapp: replace-concat + dim-check + debug logging. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp/pull/834
alex: add a non-regression unit test that simulates a mismatched partial (fake 512 response) and asserts the client throws instead of producing corrupt vectors
sam: i'll add e2e that stubs SmartRouting to return two variants across attempts and ensure client bails out cleanly
ci-bot: pipeline queued: devex/embed-batcher-parity -> started
kevin: changelog / migration note: this is a breaking change for any consumer who relied on concat semantics — add entry under "embedding-batcher: replace-on-retry, strict-dim-validation"
maya: followups assigned: sam (tests/e2e), maya (hotfix + docs), alex (changelog). ETA: tomorrow morning
kevin: thanks. also consider recommending idempotency-key header (Idempotency-Key) so servers can dedupe shard responses rather than clients trying to merge
maya: noted and will include in onboarding doc snippet
kevin: sample fix snippet for docs:
```
// validate dims
if (embedding.length !== expectedDim) {
  throw new Error(`Embedding dimension mismatch: got ${embedding.length} expected ${expectedDim}`)
}
```
maya: filing follow-up issue to scan SDK repos for other concat usages and add parity linting rule
alex: excellent — let's prioritize a small staging rollout after CI green then smoke rerank pages
kevin: assigned. :thumbsup:
